title: Oil traders shun Russian diesel after Trump-Putin deal as ruble stays strong
detail: Al Jazeera reports no Russian diesel has reached the US, with Congress's ban on Russian energy imports still in place; Peskov said all the diesel will find buyers. Meduza (Nov 6) notes the ruble remains among the strongest currencies despite a budget deficit roughly twice what authorities expected.
